headline: Proposals for a pool at 11 Lojko Drive, a dog park on L Pine Street, and two multi-family buildings at 1 Pine Street Extension.
summary: The agenda lists public comment on projects that would affect wetland buffers at 11 Lojko Drive and L Pine Street. It also covers a proposed redevelopment at 1 Pine Street Extension, Northwest Sanctuary parcels, and zoning map questions.
items: Old business: none

Public comment on Christine Sheridan's proposal at 11 Lojko Drive to install a 20’ x 36’ inground, gunite swimming pool within the wetland buffer of a critical wetland, with permanent impact to 572 SF of the wetland buffer. Map B. Lot 2818. Zone R-18 B – Suburban Residence. Ward 9.

Public comment on the City of Nashua's proposal for L Pine Street to develop a public dog park with 8 parking spaces, with permanent impact to 12,975 SF of the wetland buffer for a prime wetland. Map 77. Lot 5. Zone R-B – Urban Residence. Ward 4.

City of Nashua, 1 Pine Street Extension (NIMCO): proposal to redevelop the site by constructing 2 five-story, multi-family residential buildings, with new roads, sidewalks, surface parking, and underground parking at both buildings. Map 77. Lot 30. Zone GI/MU – General Industrial/Mixed Use. Ward 4. Subject to Shoreland Exemption – informational only (no vote).
Discussion with SPNHF staff on the possible ownership of parcel H-635 in the Northwest Sanctuary.
Parcel I-10 (Narrows Road) in the Northwest Sanctuary retained by the City for conservation.
Differentiating conservation space vs. civic in the Nashua re-CODE draft zoning map, regarding the area of the Southwest Trails (Terrell Homestead, Buckmeadow, Lovewell Pond vs. Yudicky Park).
NHACC membership renewal.
Approval of spending for trailblazing.
Draft 2027 meeting dates.
Easement monitoring for Northwest Sanctuary.
Discuss establishing a standardized fee-in-lieu monetary rate per inch DBH for non-replaceable trees.
Bishop Guertin’s day of service on November 5, 9:30am to 1:30pm.
Commissioners discussion: other.
Committee reports: easement monitoring.
Committee reports: digital marketing/website design.
Committee reports: land and trail management.
Committee reports: other.
Public comment related to items on the agenda (limited to 3 minutes per speaker).
Nonpublic session per RSA 91-A:3 (roll call vote required).
location: Room 208, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH
